The mapped hotel footprint supplies the evaluation center and bounding box. Nominatim's response is retained separately.

evaluation.evaluation_rule: Only a fully completed native candidates_found result whose top candidate distance plus the declared reference allowance is at most 1000 m can pass conditionally.
